<function name="GetSequenceActivity" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Return activity id out of sequence id. Opposite of <page>Entity:SelectWeightedSequence</page>.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="seq" type="number">The sequence ID</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The activity ID, ie <page>Enums/ACT</page></ret>
	</rets>
</function>
